customer: I've had to move my appraisal for my station wagon twice now because of VA appointments that keep shifting, and I'm worried I'm going to lose my offer over it. Can I still change the time again without getting penalized, or is my offer toast? I'm in Corlan if that matters.
agent: I'm sorry the scheduling has been such a hassle, and thank you for your service. As explained in our article "Rescheduling or canceling an appointment," you can reschedule or cancel your appraisal online, or by replying to your confirmation text, up to 2 hours before it starts, and canceling is free. Your offer stays in place as long as the new time is on or before the offer's expiration date, which you can check in "How long is my offer good for?" And even if you miss an appointment without canceling, your offer remains valid until it expires and you can book again.
